Name: Cali's Travelling Caravan House (CP and AT)
Author: calimistra
Description:
This is a retexture for the main Farmhouse building - a tiny decorated house on wheels. It is seasonal and has color masks.
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿
There are CP and AT versions available.

The Content Pack version features a toggle:
Pink Spring Petals - true, false - Toggle off to remove the pink petal overlay during spring.

I wanted to create something more whimsical, but also in-line with other buildings from Elle's Seasonal Buildings. The main color scheme matches the style of buildings from the Earthy - Color assortment.

Downloads.Description:
Place in Mods folder
Content Patcher required
